title: École normale supérieure student protest concerning graduate integration into public education and the killing of Grégory Saint-Hilaire

occurrence.finding: Radio Métropole reports a student protest at ENS on Oct. 2, before the student was killed later that evening; occurrence supported, participant count absent.

demand.finding: Graduates sought integration into the public education system.

state_target.finding: Public education system / authorities; domestic-state target indicated.

threshold.finding: No attendance count in accessible summary.

title: UEH student protest series in Port-au-Prince following Saint-Hilaire killing

occurrence_and_threshold.finding: Two contemporaneous accounts describe thousands or hundreds of UEH students on Oct. 5; Oct. 9 report calls this the fifth manifestation and reports several hundred. Counts are qualitative and refer to gatherings as described by publishers.

location.finding: Port-au-Prince, Champ de Mars / UEH area.

demands.finding: Justice/respect for student life after killing; objections to tear gas use.

response.finding: Sources describe tear gas and police dispersal; a nearby separate road-completion protest at Morne Lazare is not included in this event.

episode_boundary.finding: Oct. 6 and Oct. 7 reports call this second and third day; Oct. 9 fifth day supports series end. Oct. 2 ENS action is kept separate due distinct date/demand details.

notes: Proposed candidate only; separate scientific review must assess episode ownership and whether reported “hundreds/thousands” sufficiently establishes the 50-person threshold.

title: UPAG student protest in Gonaïves over the killing of Grégory Saint-Hilaire

occurrence_and_threshold.finding: Le National reports more than 100 UPAG students in the streets; article published Oct. 7 describes the event on Oct. 5.

demand.finding: Justice in the student killing and condemnation of government.

access_limit.finding: Only the readable initial content was assessed; the site showed a login/signup gate further down. No attempt to access gated remainder.

notes: Single contemporaneous source, event date and count supported by its readable portion; pending independent review.

title: Opposition-led demonstrations reported in multiple Haitian cities

occurrence.finding: Juno7 and HaitiLibre report Oct. 17 opposition demonstrations, including small/scattered groups in Port-au-Prince and activity in provincial cities.

threshold_by_location.finding: HaitiLibre gives a collective “thousands” framing across cities, not a city-specific count; Juno7 describes PAP groups as small/scattered. Threshold unresolved for each separately countable gathering.

location.finding: Sources name Port-au-Prince, Cap-Haïtien, Gonaïves, Saint-Marc, Jacmel; no counts allocated to each. Les Cayes page fetch timed out.

demand.finding: Opposition called for President Moïse to leave and transitional government; justice/PetroCaribe also reported.

response.finding: Reports of police cordons, tear gas and local barricades; violence does not itself exclude.

notes: Multi-city collective reporting is not allocated to local counts; keep pending rather than clone a national count across locations.
